title: Microsoft Forms: sensitivity labels on forms and generated Excel files
summary: The roadmap facts and the four existing-control paths and commands are supported. Hold the briefing because it presents existing Forms settings and Purview label configuration as the only governance levers without evidence establishing that exclusive scope. The licensing notes also need to distinguish the base Forms entitlement from the still-unpublished Forms-specific labelling entitlement.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to enable sensitivity labels in Microsoft Forms.
claims.quote: Microsoft Forms will enable sensitivity labels, empowering organizations to control access and manage information protection directly within Forms.

claims.quote: Sensitivity labels will also be inherited by Excel files generated from Forms, maintaining consistent data protection across exported content.
